content:
{
  "thought": "I need to compare the average age of closed mitigative actions in the current quarter versus the previous quarter to determine if they are being closed faster or slower.",
  "tool": "generate_sql",
  "args": {
    "question": "compare average age of closed mitigative actions between current and last quarter",
    "draft_sql": "WITH quarter_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM target_close_out_date) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM target_close_out_date) AS target_quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM completed_on) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM completed_on) AS completion_quarter,
    AVG(age) AS avg_age_days
  FROM inspection_corrective_action
  WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND age IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM target_close_out_date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM target_close_out_date)
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN target_quarter = (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) * 100 + EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM CURRENT_DATE)) THEN 'Current Quarter' ELSE 'Last Quarter' END AS quarter,
  ROUND(avg_age_days, 1) AS avg_age_days
FROM quarter_stats
ORDER BY target_quarter DESC;",
    "tables": ["inspection_corrective_action"],
    "join_path": "inspection_corrective_action",
    "business_rules": ["Only include CLOSED mitigative actions", "Filter out NULL age values", "Compare average age (days) between quarters"]
  }
}

content:
{
  "thought": "I need to generate SQL to compare inspection scores across time for the same facility, identifying cases where the score decreased.",
  "tool": "generate_sql",
  "args": {
    "question": "show inspections where the score dropped compared to the previous inspection at the same facility",
    "draft_sql": "WITH ranked_inspections AS (
  SELECT 
    ir.inspection_id,
    ir.facility_id,
    ir.inspection_score,
    ir.submitted_on,
    ir.status,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ir.facility_id ORDER BY ir.submitted_on DESC) AS rn,
    LAG(ir.inspection_score) OVER (PARTITION BY ir.facility_id ORDER BY ir.submitted_on DESC) AS prev_score
  FROM inspection_report ir
  WHERE ir.active = true AND ir.status != 'DRAFT'
)
SELECT 
  ri.inspection_id,
  fac.name AS facility_name,
  ri.inspection_score AS current_score,
  ri.prev_score,
  ri.submitted_on,
  ri.status,
  (ri.inspection_score - ri.prev_score) AS score_drop
FROM ranked_inspections ri
JOIN facility fac ON ri.facility_id = fac.id
WHERE ri.prev_score IS NOT NULL 
  AND ri.inspection_score < ri.prev_score
ORDER BY ri.submitted_on DESC;",
    "tables": ["inspection_report", "facility"],
    "join_path": "inspection_report -> facility",
    "business_rules": ["exclude drafts", "only compare non-null previous scores", "order by submitted_on DESC"]
  }
}

content:
{
  "thought": "I need to calculate score improvement by comparing current quarter scores to last quarter scores for each facility.",
  "tool": "generate_sql",
  "args": {
    "question": "facilities with highest score improvement compared to last quarter",
    "draft_sql": "WITH current_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    fac.id AS facility_id,
    fac.name AS facility_name,
    ir.inspection_score AS current_score,
    ir.submitted_on AS current_date
  FROM inspection_report ir
  JOIN facility fac ON ir.facility_id = fac.id
  WHERE ir.status = 'CLOSED' AND ir.active = true
),
last_quarter_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    fac.id AS facility_id,
    fac.name AS facility_name,
    ir.inspection_score AS last_score,
    ir.submitted_on AS last_date
  FROM inspection_report ir
  JOIN facility fac ON ir.facility_id = fac.id
  WHERE ir.status = 'CLOSED' AND ir.active = true
    AND ir.submitted_on < (SELECT MAX(submitted_on) FROM inspection_report WHERE status = 'CLOSED')
    AND ir.submitted_on >= (SELECT MAX(submitted_on) FROM inspection_report WHERE status = 'CLOSED') - INTERVAL '3 months'
),
facility_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    c.facility_id,
    c.facility_name,
    c.current_score,
    COALESCE(l.last_score, 0) AS last_score,
    c.current_score - COALESCE(l.last_score, 0) AS improvement
  FROM current_scores c
  LEFT JOIN last_quarter_scores l ON c.facility_id = l.facility_id
)
SELECT 
  facility_name,
  ROUND(improvement, 2) AS score_improvement,
  current_score,
  last_score
FROM facility_scores
WHERE improvement > 0
ORDER BY improvement DESC
LIMIT 20;",
    "tables": ["inspection_report", "facility"],
    "join_path": "inspection_report -> facility",
    "business_rules": ["exclude drafts, only CLOSED inspections", "compare current quarter to last quarter"],
    "schema_hint": "table=inspection_report, metric=inspection_score, group_by=facility, compare_quarters"
  }
}

content:
{
  "thought": "User wants capex/opex totals grouped by ALL facilities — no specific facility filter. Pre-aggregate po_details and pr_details in CTEs first to avoid fan-out, then JOIN and GROUP BY fac.id.",
  "tool": "generate_sql",
  "args": {
    "question": "total capex and opex by all facilities CTE",
    "schema_hint": "WITH po_agg AS (SELECT mitigative_action_uuid AS ica_id, SUM(po_amount) AS capex_converted FROM po_details WHERE active = true GROUP BY 1), pr_agg AS (SELECT mitigative_action_uuid AS ica_id, SUM(pr_amount) AS opex_incurred FROM pr_details WHERE active = true GROUP BY 1) SELECT fac.name AS facility_name, COALESCE(SUM(ica.capex),0) AS capex_generated, COALESCE(SUM(po.capex_converted),0) AS capex_converted, COALESCE(SUM(pr.opex_incurred),0) AS opex_incurred FROM inspection_corrective_action ica JOIN inspection_report ir ON ica.inspection_id = ir.id JOIN facility fac ON ir.facility_id = fac.id LEFT JOIN po_agg po ON po.ica_id = ica.id LEFT JOIN pr_agg pr ON pr.ica_id = ica.id WHERE ica.active = true AND ir.active = true AND fac.active = true AND ir.status != 'DRAFT' GROUP BY fac.id, fac.name ORDER BY capex_generated DESC LIMIT 100;",
    "tables": [
      "inspection_corrective_action",
      "inspection_report",
      "facility",
      "po_details",
      "pr_details"
    ],
    "join_path": "inspection_corrective_action -> inspection_report -> facility, po_details/pr_details pre-aggregated by mitigative_action_uuid",
    "business_rules": [
      "Pre-aggregate po_details and pr_details in CTEs to avoid row fan-out from LEFT JOIN",
      "Exclude DRAFT inspections",
      "Only include active facilities, inspection reports, and corrective actions"
    ]
  }
}
